prompt.en: A body that is already unable to coordinate its activities acquires additional quantities of every tissue, but those tissues remain scattered. Explain why the failure of coordination persists.

level1.en: State what changed when the extra tissue was added, what did not change, and why the second of these is what determines the outcome.

clue.en: Compare the body before and after. The quantity of tissue changed. Did the arrangement of that tissue change?

level2Template.en: The quantity of tissue increased, but the ___ between the tissues did not.

text.en: The body now contains more of every tissue than before, and it still cannot act as a single unit.
Quantity increased and organisation did not, so the ___ was still absent.
